text:
ITEM 1 | Large pale green leafy greens (crisp, torn romaine-like leaves) with creamy pale off-white dressing coating them, some darker green outer leaves mixed in, scattered small golden crouton-like bread pieces and shaved pale cheese flakes on top; covers roughly 35% of plate, mound about 3 cm high, sits left-center | 120

ITEM 2 | Golden-brown breaded fillet piece with crisp, slightly bumpy coating flecked with green herbs, dry surface, flat piece about 9 cm by 6 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, sits upper-right of plate | 110

ITEM 3 | Browned, slightly glossy pieces of meat or fish-like portion with caramelized edges, topped with bright orange grated zest/shreds and some green herb flecks, moist-looking with a little sheen, cut into irregular chunks about 5 cm across and 2 cm high, sits right of the greens against the breaded piece | 95

ITEM 4 | Scattered small orange shreds and crumbs (grated citrus-like zest) and a few bits of pale crumb on the plate surface beside item 3, dry and loose | 5

ITEM 5 | Small side plate at left edge holding mixed dark green leaves with thin red onion rings and a pale bright shreds, plus a yellow corn piece with a cut round edge, dressing not visible, about 8 cm across of greens | 60

ITEM 6 | Small pale-yellow cut corn cob round at lower-left of side plate, dry and firm, about 4 cm diameter and 3 cm thick | 35
